harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Inventory web tier completed and verified. node2/node3 run nginx 1.26.3 on port 8080; node1 runs HAProxy 3.0.5 on port 80 with round-robin health-checked backends. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were preserved. SELinux remains enforcing, firewalld remains active, and all three nodes recovered after sequential restarts.
actions_performed: Installed signed RHEL AppStream packages: HAProxy on node1 and nginx on node2/node3.
Created distinct inventory pages under /var/www/inventory on both backends.
Configured HAProxy round-robin balancing with HTTP health checks.
Restricted backend port 8080 access to node1; exposed HTTP port 80 on node1.
Verified balancing, single-backend failover, automatic backend recovery, and denied backend bypass.
Retained root-only original configuration backups and restored the vendor test-page package cleanly.
Restarted exactly one node at a time and verified changed boot identities, service recovery, data integrity, and security controls.

evidence.requirement: Preserve operating-system release and kernel; use compatible software
evidence.summary: All nodes remained on RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0; final audits show supported HAProxy 3.0.5 and nginx 1.26.3 packages.
nginx is enabled and active, listens on 8080, has valid configuration, and returns the healthy node2 inventory page.
nginx is enabled and active, listens on 8080, has valid configuration, and returns the healthy node3 inventory page.
HAProxy listens on port 80 with both backend addresses, round-robin balancing, and HTTP health checks; eight requests alternated node3/node2.

evidence.requirement: Backend failure handling and automatic recovery
evidence.summary: With node2 nginx stopped, all traffic was served by node3; after restoration, node2 automatically rejoined round-robin service.

SELinux remains enforcing, firewalld and SSH remain active, backend ingress is limited to node1, node3-to-node2 backend bypass was denied, vendor package verification is clean, /etc/hosts checksums are unchanged, and original configs are retained mode 0600.

Healthy baseline boot ID 22045032-4379-47d6-bbf6-319fdca89750, acknowledged reboot and observed disconnect, changed boot ID 706e1532-63f1-462e-8474-e60dce6c3eb0, then verified HAProxy, port 80, alternating responses, configuration, SSH, firewalld, and SELinux recovery.

Healthy baseline boot ID 21972395-6444-42bf-8e37-5c3108194a7d, acknowledged reboot and observed disconnect, changed boot ID 56575ac0-a54d-466f-9329-3b42ed6482cd, then verified nginx, inventory data/checksums, security controls, and automatic HAProxy reintegration.

Healthy baseline boot ID 050a5b4c-6c7b-42ad-957a-b6a41a0d34db, acknowledged reboot and observed disconnect, changed boot ID c8f92d90-020f-4d57-96ba-96d1556f0ba3, then verified nginx, port 8080, inventory data/checksums, SSH, firewalld, and SELinux recovery.
